people.imagined: The far end of the ice at dawn. She has been sitting so long that two sparrows have landed on her knees; the viewer must say her name three times. She is nearing the eighth layer and keeps what she suspects.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the ice at dawn, utterly motionless, two small brown sparrows perched on her knees, her eyes closed or barely open. Face: most important, the sparrows: two plump brown sparrows sitting calmly on her folded knees at the bottom of the frame, one looking at the viewer. A pale, still, oval face with frost-white lashes; calm, half-lidded grey eyes just opening; smooth straight brows; a small nose; a closed, peaceful mouth; a faint blue-white rime on her cheeks. Hair: black, in a plain low knot under a wide straw hat. Body: seated upright, legs folded, shoulders loose. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey fisher's robe with a crossed collar; a straw rain cape, pale gold, spread round her shoulders and hem; a wide straw hat with a blue cord under the chin; felt boots. Hands and objects: her hands resting open on her knees beside the sparrows; at her feet a round dark ice hole with a line sunk in it. Background: a vast white frozen river, pale mist, a faint pink sunrise. Light: cold pale pink and blue dawn light from the upper left. Expression: patient, still, withdrawn. A faint blue-white hint of water and ice qi in the frost.

people.imagined: The harbour at the escort's start, a hundred oars. He bellows across the ice-edge for the boats to line up, and his big flat hands rest on his hips. He wants the Keeper to be his old friend.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a boat's bow he cups one huge hand to his mouth and bellows at the fleet behind the viewer. Face: most important, the hands and the open mouth: huge broad flat whaler's hands, thick and scarred, one cupped round the mouth and one spread on the hip, in the foreground; the mouth wide open. A broad, flat, red-brown face; thick dark brows; small, bright, honest eyes; a wide nose broken once; a thick black beard flecked with frost. Frost clings to his moustache and his cheeks are flushed raw with cold. Hair: black and thick, tied at the nape with a leather thong, a wide straw hat pushed back. Body: huge, barrel-chested, planted wide. Clothing: a thick quilted indigo fisher's robe with a crossed collar and the sleeves rolled; a straw rain cape over the shoulders; a leather belt with a harpoon-head tucked in; heavy boots. Hands and objects: a long oar held under one arm. A coil of rope lies at his feet and a boat hook leans against the gunwale. Background: a grey harbour with broken ice floes, a row of boats with oars lifted, pale mist. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. Expression: a loud, impatient, honest bellow with the brows drawn together and the mouth wide open; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The fish landing. He counts the ice-fish on his fingers with his lips moving, earnest and chubby; he has begun to learn the abacus and doesn't know why.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a pile of silver fish on a quay he counts them on his fingers, lips moving. Face: most important, the moving lips and the counting fingers: his lips pursed in a silent count and his left hand held up with fingers bent one by one, large in the frame. A round, chubby, earnest face with pink cheeks; wide, serious brown eyes; short thin brows; a small nose; full lips. Hair: dark brown, short and combed flat, under a small straw hat. Body: round, soft and short, shoulders sloped. His round tummy pushes against the jacket's toggles and his knees are bent in a wide squat. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey fisher's jacket with short sleeves (outer disciple) and toggles; a small straw rain cape; a woven belt with a tally cord; felt boots. Hands and objects: the counting hand; the right hand holding a slim split-reed stick used as a tally. Four silver fish lie lined up on the planks by his knee, and the tally stick has five small notches cut along its edge. Background: a pile of frosted silver fish on wet planks, boats and grey sky. Light: soft cool light from the upper left. Pale light also shines along the wet scales of the fish, giving his cheeks a cold pink flush. Expression: Eager, round eyes and a trusting, content face with lips moving over the count, earnest and chubby-cheeked. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The Liên Giang fish stall. She guts a fish with a quick wrist, listening hard to a servant of the Liễu house chatting, a hand ready for the forgotten change.
people.subject: The moment: at a fish stall she slits open a silver fish with a quick wrist, her head turned sharp toward someone speaking off frame. Face: most important, the glittering forearms: both forearms bare to the elbow and glittering with fish scales, silver and rainbow flecks stuck to the skin, in the foreground. A broad, bright, brown face with wide cheeks; quick, sharp, black eyes; arched brows; a wide mouth in a canny half-smile; a scale on one cheek. A fleck of dark fish slime marks her lower lip. Hair: black, tied up in a scarf of faded blue cotton, a loose curl. Body: sturdy, broad, quick. Clothing: a plain faded indigo blouse with the sleeves rolled above the elbow; a long oilcloth apron wet and silvery; a cord belt with a small knife; a small cloth purse hidden in the sleeve; an old straw hat on her back. Hands and objects: a broad gutting knife in the right hand; a fish in the left. Background: a wooden stall with hanging dried fish, a crowd blurred. Silver fish lie in baskets of ice and a gull watches from a post at the stall's edge. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. Expression: a canny, gregarious half-smile with the eyes on the speaker and one ear cocked, a girl who listens as she gutters and is ready for the forgotten change; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: At his ice hole on a winter morning. A girl passes behind him and he goes red to the ears, his long reed-cutter's arms folded in tight. He was told to watch how she sits and he watches nothing else.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an ice hole he looks sideways over his shoulder at someone passing, his ears bright red. Face: most important, the red ears and the flush: both ears and cheeks bright crimson against the white frost around him. A long, thin, brown face with a wide jaw; large, soft, brown eyes; faint brows; a long nose; a half-open, helpless mouth. Hair: brown, long and unkempt, with a few reed-flower fluffs caught in it, under a tilted straw hat. Body: tall, gangly, very long arms, awkwardly folded. His knees are drawn up high and his big hands hang between them, as if he had too many limbs to arrange. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey robe with a crossed collar, the sleeves a little short for his arms; a long straw rain cape; a blue cord at the neck; felt boots. Hands and objects: very long arms and large hands folded across his knees; beside him an ice hole with a line, a reed whistle on a cord. A thin line runs from the hole beside him to a short reed rod propped in the snow, and a second empty hole, neatly cut, sits a pace away. Background: white ice, a faint dark figure walking away, pale mist. Light: cool pale light from the upper left. The low light turns his reddened ears translucent, with a glow of pink at the rims. Expression: A shy, sidelong glance with ears burning red, a humble, helpless half-smile and soft, trusting eyes. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The boat, after the third watch. He rows and then folds his hands when not rowing, as the Pavilion taught, and his split lips never smile. He held a weaker boy's face to the ice for the lesson.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a boat, he rests with hands folded in his lap exactly, looking coolly at the viewer. Face: most important, the wind-split lips and the folded hands: both lips cracked with dark red splits and dried rust-brown crust at the corners, and two pale hands folded precisely one over the other at the frame's bottom. A narrow, pale, severe face with a long jaw; cold, calm, light-grey eyes; thin straight brows; a thin nose; a flat, thin mouth. Tiny frost crystals cling to his lashes. Hair: black, tied back in a tight tail under a straw hat. Body: tall, straight, tidy, shoulders level. His spine does not touch the boat's rib; he sits as if on a bench in a hall, knees together. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey robe with a high collar, clean and neatly buttoned; a pale straw cape set exactly square; a leather belt; calloused knuckles. The indigo quilting is evenly stitched and the buttons are polished horn. Hands and objects: the folded hands, raw red along the palm edges from the oar, which leans against the thwart with its grip dark with old stains. Background: a grey river and a long oar laid across the boat. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. A thin pale line of light lies along the oar and his cracked lips, leaving the eyes in shadow under the hat brim. Expression: a cool, patient, flat calm with a cruelty that never reaches the pale eyes; a faint blue-white hint of water qi.

people.imagined: First freeze. She has cut the holes and keeps the tally of the dead's holes; the knotted hemp cord on her wrist is as thick as a bracelet. She wants to know why the old sitters cut theirs in pairs.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on new ice with an ice chisel, she looks up from a half-cut hole, one wrist raised. Face: most important, the tally cord: a thick cord of knotted hemp wound many times round her left wrist like a heavy bracelet, with dozens of knots, large and clear. A young, stern, round face with pink windburnt cheeks; steady, dark brown eyes; thick straight brows; a small nose; a firm, closed mouth. Hair: black, in two braids wound up under a straw hat. Body: short, strong, kneeling. Her knees are planted in the snow, her back bowed over the work, and her breath makes short clouds. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey jacket with short sleeves; a straw rain cape pushed back; a blue cord at the neck; thick felt leggings. Hands and objects: a long iron ice chisel in her right hand; the wrist cord raised. Ice chips lie in a ring around the hole she is cutting, and a short row of paired holes, each with a knot of hemp cord tied to a peg beside it, runs away behind her. Background: a half-cut round hole in white ice, a line of finished holes receding in pairs. Light: pale cold light from the upper left. The frost on the ice scatters tiny blue sparkles over her gloves and the cord on her wrist. Expression: A stubborn, brave look from the half-cut hole, brows drawn down, her lips set, and a reverent, questioning shadow in the eyes. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The head at his ice hole in winter. He speaks as if each word cost a fish. The hook has been dropped through the ice every winter since 1120. The seat of his robe is worn through and he will not mend it.
people.subject: The moment: seated at his ice hole, he holds a fine line in one hand and looks at the viewer in silence. Face: most important, the frost beard: a long thin grey beard rimed white with frost in every season, each hair furred with ice crystals, hanging to the chest. A long, thin, grey face with hollow cheeks; deep-set, patient, pale eyes; long grey brows with frost; a long nose; a thin, closed mouth. Frost lies white in the hollows of his cheeks and on his lashes. Hair: grey, in a topknot under a wide straw hat with a blue cord. Body: thin, stooped, narrow. Clothing: a thick quilted indigo-grey robe with a crossed collar, faded, its seat worn through and left unmended on purpose, the one flaw he keeps (a sworn habit rather than poverty), the rest of the robe clean and sound; a long frost-white straw cape; felt boots. Hands and objects: a bone-white fishhook on a river-silk line held between finger and thumb, the line running down into the hole at his feet. Background: a vast white river, a low grey sky, a faint line of hills. A line of pale mist drifts low over the river and a black raven stands far off on the ice. Light: cold pale light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, devout, sparing stillness, the pale eyes on the line; a faint blue-white hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The grand elder on the ice, so still that he looks like a heap of snow. A frost-white cape of three hundred winters; he lifts his head and the snow seems to speak.
people.subject: The moment: a tiny figure so covered in white straw cape that he resembles a snow heap, lifting his face slowly out of it. Face: most important, the snow cape: a huge cape of straw gone white with frost, shaped like a conical haystack covering his whole body to the ground, its straw furred with ice, filling most of the frame. A tiny, ancient, nut-brown face as wrinkled as dried fruit; bright, small, black eyes; long white eyebrows; a tiny nose; a toothless, calm, kind smile; a few white whiskers. Frost whitens each whisker. Hair: white, wispy, escaping from a wide straw hat shaped like a bowl with a cord. Body: tiny, huddled, round as a boulder. Clothing: the white straw cape and hat; beneath them the glimpse of an old quilted indigo robe; no ornament. Hands and objects: one small, brown, wrinkled hand emerging with an old gourd; a black river pebble held in the other. The old gourd is cracked at the lip and its cord is worn smooth. Background: a flat white ice field and pale sky, nothing else. Light: soft white light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, content, honest, toothless smile with bright, kind eyes; a faint blue-white hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The boat yard on a bright marsh morning. She is married to the head and runs everything that does not involve sitting still; the reed-flower pins in her hair are white as summer snow.
people.subject: The moment: striding along a quay with orders on her tongue, she half turns, the abacus at her belt swinging. Face: most important, the reed-flower pins: a half-dozen white feathery reed-flower sprays pinned in her hair like a crown, bright against black. A round, brisk, brown face with bright cheeks; quick, shrewd, dark eyes; arched brows; a snub nose; a wide, smiling mouth. Hair: black, in a high round coil, the reed-flower pins. Body: sturdy, short, quick, shoulders broad. Her chin is lifted, her stride long for her height, and her free hand sweeps out as she gives an order. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey jacket with a crossed collar and bright blue cord trim; a short straw rain cape; a long skirt; a leather belt with a small brass abacus hanging; her sleeves pushed up. Hands and objects: a rolled paper (blank) in her left hand; the right pointing. The abacus at her belt has twelve rows of brown wooden beads and swings with her step; a pair of reed-flower sprays also tuck behind her left ear. Background: a boat-yard with hulls on trestles, white reed flowers in a marsh beyond. Light: bright clear light from the upper left. The white flowers in her hair take a bright rim light, almost like a halo of snow. Expression: pragmatic, genial, shrewd. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: Dawn at Tuyết Đăng Trấn harbour. The skin of ice over the water; he breaks it with his elbow, red-faced and laughing, because he is the one who cannot sit still.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour quay at dawn he swings his bent right elbow down through a skin of ice with a roar. Face: most important, the red face and the elbow: a huge flushed brick-red face, shouting, and the bent elbow in the foreground with shards of ice flying. A loud, broad, red face; small, merry, bloodshot blue eyes; thick sandy brows; a wide nose; a gap-toothed grin; a stubbly beard. Frost whitens his eyebrows and the tips of his sandy beard. Hair: sandy, thick and untidy, a leather band round the forehead. A few strands steam in the cold. Body: big, bull-necked, restless. His barrel chest heaves with the shout, steam rolls from his mouth, and his heavy shoulders are rounded forward. Clothing: a heavy quilted indigo robe worn open at the throat, sleeves cut short at the elbow; a straw cape thrown back; a rope belt with a cutlass; high boots. Hands and objects: the elbow, wrapped with a strip of cloth; the other hand holding a boat hook. A wet cloth is wound round the elbow he swings; the boat hook in his other hand has a rusted iron tip and a rope loop. Background: a misty harbour, grey ice, black masts, pale pink dawn. Light: pink-gold dawn light from the upper left. Low pink light catches the flying shards of ice, each one a small bright spark in front of his face. Expression: a loud, bold, red-faced roar of glee, small merry eyes wide and the gap-toothed mouth open; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The stall in the market. He grins to show the gold tooth he's proud of while his stained thumb presses on the scale; he counts every scale of the tax twice.
people.subject: The moment: behind a fish stall he grins broadly with one thumb pressed on a hanging scale's pan. Face: most important, the gold tooth: a single upper front tooth capped in bright yellow gold, shining in his wide grin. A round, sly, ruddy face; small bright black eyes; thin eyebrows; a round nose; a trimmed moustache. Hair: black, oiled, in a small knot under a felt cap. Body: stocky, middling height. He leans forward over the counter on both forearms, his round stomach pressing against the plank edge. Clothing: a good indigo-grey quilted coat with a crossed collar, clean; a short straw cape thrown on the back; a leather apron; fish-scale stains on the thumb. Hands and objects: the scale with a silver fish in the pan; his thumb stained pale with scales; an abacus on the counter. The scale's pan holds a single silver ice-fish, its tail curved, and the beam is tilted slightly toward his side; a small abacus with black beads lies beside it. Background: a market stall, hanging dried fish, a cloth awning. Light: bright cold daylight from the upper left. The cloth awning above tints everything pale blue, and a bright spot of reflected light sits on the gold tooth. Expression: greedy, hearty, canny. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: On the ice at night, the way her grandmother taught her brother. In the morning she will show her teacher a wrong posture on purpose; her half-smile hides it.
people.subject: The moment: seated at her hole on the ice, she turns a half-smile on someone standing over her, her back purposely slumped. Face: most important, the narrow chin and half-smile: a distinctly narrow, sharp, pointed chin, and a small half-smile that lifts only one corner. A thin, pale, finely made face; clever, light-grey, hooded eyes; thin, neat brows; a small straight nose. Hair: black, in a loose knot under a wide straw hat, a thread of pale blue ribbon. Body: slender, sitting deliberately in an imperfect posture. Her shoulders are rounded forward on purpose and her chin is tucked, an obvious fault in posture. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey robe with a crossed collar, fine and well fitted, with a blue cord edging; a straw rain cape set on one shoulder; a wide straw hat shaped in the old river style; gloves. Hands and objects: both hands tucked into her sleeves; beside her a frozen hole with a line. The hole beside her is perfectly round with a thin rim of new ice, and a single white reed-flower is tucked into the cord of her hat. Background: a night ice field, faint stars, a lantern far away. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left. Stars show faintly over her shoulder, and a very small lantern glow far across the ice gives a warm point behind her. Expression: A mild, careful half-smile with lowered lids and watchful eyes that hide the lie, loyal in manner and sly in the corners of the mouth. A faint blue-white hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The afternoon watch. He ships his oar and lets another man pull both sides, grinning in the sun-slackened way of someone who believes it will all come out. His shoulders are an oarsman's.
people.subject: The moment: slouched in a boat with his oar shipped across his knees and his hands behind his head, grinning lazily. Face: most important, the oarsman's shoulders and the grin: shoulders enormously broad and thickly muscled under the open jacket, and a wide, lazy grin. A broad, sun-browned, handsome face; half-closed, sleepy brown eyes; thick brows; a short nose; a slack, easy smile. Hair: black, tousled, with a straw hat tipped over one eye. Body: broad-shouldered, lazy, sprawled. His chest is bare under the open vest, tanned deeply across the broad ribs, with a faint sunburn line at the collar bone. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey vest open over a bare chest, the sleeves short; a straw cape under him like a cushion; a rope belt; bare forearms. Hands and objects: an oar lying across his thighs; a fishing line over the gunwale. The line over the gunwale has a small cork float, and a half-eaten flat cake sits on the thwart beside a leather water bottle. Background: a grey river, a faint boat, afternoon haze. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. A slanting warm light lies across his shoulders, making his skin look the colour of bronze. Expression: A slack, sun-warmed grin with half-closed eyes, an easy, careless brow and the confidence of a man who thinks it will all come out. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: Morning on the ice beside the old man. Small for his age, with the cracked fingertips of a net-mender; he sits patiently and does not shiver.
people.subject: The moment: a small boy sits cross-legged on the ice next to a huge white shape (just the edge of a pale cape) and holds his hands out in front. Face: most important, the cracked fingertips: ten fingertips split and red-cracked and calloused, held open in the foreground, with scraps of net-twine around the wrists. A small, thin, earnest, brown face with big dark eyes; faint brows; a small nose; a small patient mouth. His nose and cheeks are pink with cold. Hair: black, short, a cowlick, under an oversized straw hat tied with blue cord. Body: small, thin, sitting very straight. His small knees are tucked tight to his chest and his back is perfectly straight, barely moving. Clothing: an outer disciple's short-sleeved quilted indigo jacket, a little too large; a small straw rain cape; wool leggings; felt boots. A scarf of blue wool is tucked neatly into the collar. Hands and objects: the hands held out; a net in his lap, half-mended, with a bone needle stuck through a mesh and a ball of twine rolled against his thigh. Background: a white ice field, pale sky, the edge of a pale straw cape at the right. Light: cold pale light from the upper left. The pale light shows each crack in his fingertips as a thin red line; his breath makes no cloud. Expression: a patient, humble, trusting stillness, the small face grave and untroubled by the cold; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The ice in the school, a merchant's daughter who has not learned to take off her bright earrings for the ice. Her eyes slide toward the head steward's sealed pages.
people.subject: The moment: seated on ice with her gloves off she tilts her head, letting two large earrings swing, her eyes sliding sideways. Face: most important, the earrings: two large bright gold-and-coral drop earrings, long and glittering, hung from her ears against the dull indigo and straw. A pretty, sharp, pale face with a pointed chin; clever dark eyes; thin curved brows; a small nose; a red-painted mouth in a small smile. A little powder pales her cheeks and a fine blush of cold shows on her nose. Hair: black, in an elaborate knot under a straw hat, with a coral comb. Body: slender, a little too fashionable for the ice. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey robe of good silk with a crossed collar and a blue cord; a straw rain cape on one shoulder; a thin gold chain at the neck; fine gloves in her lap. Hands and objects: her bare hands folded, rings on two fingers; folded papers (blank) tucked in her sleeve. Her nails are neatly shaped and rubbed pink, the nails of a hand that has never gutted a fish. Background: a white ice field, a boat house, a pale sky. Light: pale cool light from the upper left; glints off the earrings. Expression: a sly, pretty, ambitious little smile with the eyes sliding toward the steward's pages, a girl who has not learned to take off her earrings for the ice; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The sail-watcher's cottage. She hums in a sing-song drawl as she makes up a bed for her cousin who failed the Frost Test three times. Her thumb has a sail-cloth callus.
people.subject: The moment: smoothing a folded quilt on a bed with a cheerful sing-song hum, looking over her shoulder with a smile. Face: most important, the callused thumb: the right thumb thick with a long yellow-white callus ridge, held out in the foreground as she smooths the quilt. A round, warm, tanned face with dimples; bright, kind, brown eyes; thick, soft brows; a button nose; a wide, easy smile. A dimple shows beside her mouth on each side and her cheeks are rosy. Hair: dark brown, in two loose braids tied with blue string. Body: stout, comfortable, strong arms. Her broad hips and arms fill the space between the bed and the wall, and she stands on the balls of her feet. Clothing: a quilted indigo-grey jacket with short sleeves (outer disciple) and a crossed collar; a faded blue kerchief; a long grey skirt; a small straw rain cape hung on a peg behind her. Hands and objects: the callused thumb; a folded quilt; a worn sail-cloth bag. The quilt is pieced in squares of blue, grey and one red square, and a clay hot-water bottle sits waiting at its foot. Background: a small whitewashed cottage room, a window with grey sea. Light: warm soft light from the window at the upper left. Light through the window falls on the quilt and warms the edge of her braid. Dust turns slowly in the window beam. Expression: a warm, forgiving, easy smile with soft eyes, the calm cheer of a cousin who has already made up the bed; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: 1140, carrying the petition to the Pavilion. A memorial portrait of the loud, broad co-founder with a gap-toothed laugh and fish-scale scars on both hands, laughing even as he sits on thin spring ice.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a broad man laughing, seated on thin spring ice with his hands open on his knees. Face: most important, the laugh and the scarred hands: a wide laughing mouth with a gap between the front teeth, and both open hands covered with small pale fish-scale scars like silver scales, large in the foreground. A broad, ruddy, handsome face with thick black brows; bright, merry, dark eyes crinkled; a short flat nose; a thick black beard. Hair: black, in a topknot under a wide straw hat. A few grey hairs show at the temple under the hat brim. Body: broad, round-shouldered, solid, leaning slightly forward. His chest is wide and his belly round, and his head is thrown back so that his beard points upward. His wrists are thick and corded under the quilting. Clothing: a quilted indigo robe with a crossed collar, a straw cape; a leather belt; a rolled scroll (blank) under his arm. Hands and objects: several of the fish-scale scars overlap on the heel of each palm, and a rolled blank scroll tied with blue cord sticks from his belt. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a hint of a thin sheet of ice. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, dark vignette. The yellowed silk gives his laughing face a faint amber tint, darker around the beard. Expression: a brave, impatient, helpless laugh with the head thrown back and the beard pointing upward; a faint blue hint of water qi, softened by the fade.
